summary: Stocks mixed midday near records as chips lagged and oil jumped. Columbus Day keeps the bond market closed while earnings season looms.
market_note: S&P flat, Nasdaq lower on chip weakness; big bank earnings start Tuesday.

items.why: Up on early traction for its Muse AI assistant. Sensor Tower data showed 7 day retention over 30 percent and 2.8 million downloads in two weeks, fueling renewed optimism around Meta AI roadmap.
Pulled back as Microsoft unveiled its Maia 300 AI chip, signaling more custom in house silicon that could cut into third party GPU demand. Profit taking and OpenAI spending jitters added pressure.
Crude rallied on fresh Middle East risk after Houthi strikes hit a Riyadh airport and tankers near the Strait of Hormuz, plus doubts over Trump Russia Ukraine energy ceasefire.
Slipped as Microsoft Maia 300 launch underscored the shift toward in house inference chips at hyperscalers. Technicians also flag a possible topping pattern after the run to record highs.
